settings.heading: Start with a clear direction.
settings.body: A practical guide to exploring and working with Quadratum.

settings.heading: 01 / Evaluate the experience.
settings.body: Open an industry demo, compare product and collection layouts, and follow the customer journey. Campaign images introduce the direction; the linked storefront is the interactive example.
settings.label: Open the showcase

settings.heading: 02 / Compose your store.
settings.body: Choose a starting presentation in the theme editor. Add sections, arrange blocks and connect the products and collections appropriate to your store. Template files alone do not create catalog or page records.
settings.label: Explore the layout library

settings.heading: 03 / Bring your content.
settings.body: Supply your own product photography, descriptions, inventory, policies and contact details. Replace demo copy and check every destination before launch.

settings.heading: 04 / Review before publishing.
settings.body: Review mobile and desktop layouts, navigation, forms and the cart with your real catalog. Confirm accessibility, performance, licensing and applicable platform requirements before publication.
settings.label: Preview boundaries
